scripts.build:adapter-sdk: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @family-ai/provider-adapter-sdk
scripts.build:agent-broker: npm run build:adapter-sdk && npm run build -w @family-ai/agent-broker
scripts.build:gateway: npm run build:adapter-sdk && npm run build -w @family-ai/gateway
scripts.build: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:agent-broker
scripts.test:workspaces: npm run build:adapter-sdk && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/report-current-runtime.test.mjs scripts/check-database-open-intents.test.mjs scripts/check-gateway-database-lock-entrypoints.test.mjs scripts/gateway-container-timeout-contract.test.mjs && node scripts/check-database-open-intents.mjs && node scripts/check-gateway-database-lock-entrypoints.mjs && bash scripts/test-static-check-secret-pattern.sh && bash scripts/static-check.sh
scripts.test: npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:adapter-sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:federation-bootstrap-runtime && npm run test:gateway-wal-recovery-runtime
scripts.recover:gateway-database:dev: npm run build:gateway && python3 apps/gateway/runtime/gateway_lock_exec.py --database-from-env GATEWAY_DATABASE_PATH -- node apps/gateway/dist/recoverGatewayDatabase.js
scripts.provision:federation-service:dev: npm run build:gateway && python3 apps/gateway/runtime/gateway_lock_exec.py --database-from-env GATEWAY_DATABASE_PATH -- node apps/gateway/dist/provisionFederationService.js
